curves: existing canonical sample_order; x=column,y=row; no orientation search or reflection
mapping: full-grid valid-cell curve rank/(grid sample count-1), mapped to shared fixed physical canvas; rounded at original L; no per-frame feature rank packing
anchors: same original extremum sample IDs as Anchor Exact; SNS/TW source points are same support centroids
TW: shared stable distance-tie ordering by leaf ID; require0<k<n/2; missing neverzero
NPE: time mean of frame max abs(final position - frozen q)/canvas
interpretation: sample-domain spatial baselines, no topology preservation or finite feature-support layout guarantee; quantization collisions retained and reported
